Neha / Laura — quick take from Channel / Pricing:

- Recommend structuring as: 15% customer discount + 12% reseller commission. 12% is within our standard partner band for integrations and keeps gross margin acceptable.
- If Emily insists on 18% up-front, propose that we make 18% conditional: either a 24-month term or a 1-year term with a 20% higher committed spend threshold (we'd then build a performance rebate clause).
- Add a clause for a quarterly true-up if consumption exceeds the commit (this preserves economics and avoids mid-year write-offs).
- Invoice path (Redwood → Optimus) is fine; ensure the PO includes ResellCo as a partner for the reseller statement of work so finance has an external payee reference.

From a quick margin simulation I ran (see reseller_commission_matrix.xlsx), 15% + 12% keeps effective net revenue > 65% list at the expected volumes; 18% + 12% drops net revenue to ~62% which is a bit low without term extension.

If Finance signs off, I'll draft the private-offer language and partner SOW callouts.
